title.en: Fujitsu announces FUJITSU-MONAKA and a sovereign AI server
title.zhHans: Fujitsu 宣布 FUJITSU-MONAKA 与主权 AI 服务器

searchSummary.en: Fujitsu announced a Japan-designed 2nm 3D-stacked FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU and a Japan-made MONAKA Server, with sales planned from November 2026 and shipments to Japan and Europe planned from April 2027.
searchSummary.zhHans: Fujitsu 宣布日本设计的 2nm 3D 堆叠 FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU 和日本制造的 MONAKA Server，计划于 2026 年 11 月开始销售，并计划自 2027 年 4 月起向日本和欧洲出货。

summary.en: On September 14, Fujitsu announced the FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU and Fujitsu MONAKA Server for what it calls sovereign AI infrastructure. The company describes a 2nm core paired with 5nm cache and I/O components in a 3D-stacked design, with a maximum frequency of 3.8GHz and memory transfer speed of 8800MT/s. CPU and server sales are planned from November 2026; Fujitsu says server shipments to Japan and Europe will begin sequentially from April 2027.
summary.zhHans: 9 月 14 日，Fujitsu 宣布 FUJITSU-MONAKA CPU 和 Fujitsu MONAKA Server，并将其定位为主权 AI 基础设施。公司称产品采用 2nm 核心与 5nm 缓存和 I/O 组件的 3D 堆叠设计，最高频率 3.8GHz，内存传输速度 8800MT/s。CPU 和服务器计划于 2026 年 11 月开始销售；Fujitsu 称服务器将自 2027 年 4 月起陆续向日本和欧洲出货。

narrative.en: Fujitsu positions MONAKA around domestic design and manufacturing, air-cooled deployment, resource pooling, and supply-chain traceability for organizations that want local control over data and infrastructure. The company says the CPU provides twice the AI-inference throughput of other CPUs and that selected server designs can reduce cooling power; independent coverage repeats those figures as Fujitsu claims. The official direct page was blocked by a Vercel checkpoint during capture, so the company release is preserved through PR Newswire and cross-checked with independent reports. Sales and shipments are future dates, not evidence of deployed performance.
narrative.zhHans: Fujitsu 将 MONAKA 定位于本土设计与制造、风冷部署、资源池化及供应链可追溯，面向希望在本地控制数据和基础设施的组织。公司称该 CPU 的 AI 推理吞吐量是其他 CPU 的两倍，部分服务器设计可降低冷却功耗；独立报道将这些数字作为 Fujitsu 的主张转述。采集期间 Fujitsu 官方直达页面被 Vercel 安全检查拦截，因此保留了 PR Newswire 上的公司发布，并与独立报道交叉核对。销售和出货日期均在未来，不能作为已部署性能的证据。

description.en: Adds a Japan-made CPU/server route to the sovereign-AI infrastructure market, targeting data-center, enterprise, academic, HPC, and defense use cases.
description.zhHans: 为主权 AI 基础设施市场增加日本制造的 CPU 和服务器路径，面向数据中心、企业、学术、高性能计算和国防场景。

description.en: Proposes a CPU-centered inference option for sites with power, cooling, or supply-chain constraints, although throughput and efficiency remain unverified company claims.
description.zhHans: 为受电力、冷却或供应链限制的场所提出以 CPU 为中心的推理选项，但吞吐量和效率仍是未经独立验证的公司主张。

text.en: Fujitsu announced FUJITSU-MONAKA and the Fujitsu MONAKA Server on September 14, describing a 2nm/5nm 3D-stacked design and planned November 2026 sales.
text.zhHans: Fujitsu 于 9 月 14 日宣布 FUJITSU-MONAKA 和 Fujitsu MONAKA Server，介绍了 2nm/5nm 3D 堆叠设计，并计划于 2026 年 11 月销售。

text.en: The company positions the server for sovereign AI infrastructure in Japan and Europe and says shipments to those markets will begin sequentially from April 2027.
text.zhHans: 公司将该服务器定位为日本和欧洲的主权 AI 基础设施，并称这些市场将自 2027 年 4 月起陆续开始出货。

text.en: The twice-throughput, lower-power, sovereign-infrastructure, and future-availability claims are Fujitsu's claims or plans and require post-launch independent testing.
text.zhHans: 两倍吞吐量、低功耗、主权基础设施和未来可用性等说法均为 Fujitsu 的主张或计划，需要上市后的独立测试。

editorial.reviewNotes: Provisional L2 sovereign-infrastructure node. Announcement and scheduled dates are confirmed; performance and future shipments remain attributed or prospective.
